title: Gold Frm nd More
features:
The Build a Boat for Treasure script, featuring gold farm and teleport functionalities, transforms the player's adventure by automating resource collection and enhancing mobility. 

The gold farm feature continuously gathers in-game currency, allowing players to amass wealth effortlessly and focus on constructing innovative and powerful boats. 

Meanwhile, the teleport function provides instant travel across the game's map, facilitating quick access to various locations and treasure spots. 

These capabilities not only streamline the gameplay but also significantly boost efficiency and enjoyment, enabling players to maximize their building potential and achieve their treasure-hunting goals with greater ease and excitement.
